{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# Identify duplicates and keep only the highest sample_seq for each patient
duplicates = data.duplicated(subset='patient_id', keep=False)
num_duplicate_rows = duplicates.sum()
num_unique_patients = len(data) - num_duplicate_rows

# Alternatively, use groupby to get unique patient count after deduplication
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
num_enrolled_patients = len(data_dedup)

print("Number of duplicate rows:", num_duplicate_rows)
print("Number of unique patients after deduplication:", num_enrolled_patients)"}
